facts.text: CCS offers accelerated programs that allow students to earn both a Bachelor of Fine Arts and a Master of Fine Arts in five years, eliminating a full year of tuition.

sources.title: New Degrees Prepare Students for the Future of Creative Careers
sources.quote: CCS is launching new accelerated degree programs that give students the unique opportunity to complete both a Bachelor of Fine Arts and a Master of Fine Arts in five years, removing a full year of tuition
